extracted.name: Red Salmon Pâté
extracted.description: A creamy salmon pâté flavored with onion, horseradish, lemon juice, and parsley. Delicious spread on crackers or toast.
ingredient_lines: 1 (7 ounce) can salmon, drained, flaked and bones removed
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, mix together salmon, cream cheese, horseradish, lemon juice, and onion. Chill if necessary until firm enough to handle, then form into a ball. Roll in parsley and pecans if desired. Refrigerate until serving. Serve with assorted crackers.
